topic: Texas City disaster (1947): a fire aboard the Grandcamp preceded its 9:12 explosion, and another ship exploded the next day

research_sources.institution: Texas Fire Prevention and Engineering Bureau / National Board of Fire Underwriters (1947)

research_cautions: Do not assert a single ignition source or blame one person; distinguish the Grandcamp and High Flyer explosions.
The 1947 report's online photographs are not assumed reusable without an image-specific rights check.
